name: WeKnora
description: Turns documents into a queryable knowledge base with RAG question answering, a ReAct agent orchestrating retrieval, MCP tools and web search, and an auto-generated wiki.

skills.name: Document Ingestion
skills.description: Parses PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, EPUB, images and more, with per-upload parser, chunking, OCR and VLM settings plus batch reparse.

skills.name: Hybrid Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves passages via BM25, dense vectors, GraphRAG and parent-child chunking across pgvector, Elasticsearch, Milvus and Qdrant.

skills.name: ReAct Reasoning Agent
skills.description: Runs progressive multi-step ReAct reasoning that autonomously chains knowledge retrieval, MCP tools and web search to reach an answer.

skills.name: Auto Wiki Generation
skills.description: Distills raw documents into structured interlinked Markdown wiki pages with an interactive knowledge graph browser in the UI.

skills.name: Data Source Sync
skills.description: Auto-syncs knowledge from Feishu, Notion, Yuque and RSS with incremental or full sync, and serves answers through IM and widgets.
